scripts.check: pnpm --filter uncial run check && pnpm --filter uncial-wagtail run check && pnpm --filter uncial-cms run check && pnpm --filter uncial-docs run check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter uncial run test && pnpm --filter uncial-wagtail run test && pnpm --filter uncial-cms run test && pnpm --filter uncial-docs run test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter uncial run build && pnpm --filter uncial-wagtail run build && pnpm --filter uncial-cms run build && pnpm --filter uncial-docs run build
scripts.build:wagtail: pnpm --filter uncial run build && pnpm --filter uncial-wagtail run build
scripts.wagtail:setup: uv sync --project packages/uncial-wagtail && pnpm --filter uncial-wagtail run demo:migrate && pnpm --filter uncial-wagtail run demo:seed
scripts.wagtail:serve: echo '>> Wagtail demo admin → http://localhost:8000/admin/  (login: admin / admin)' && pnpm --filter uncial-wagtail run demo
scripts.dev:wagtail: pnpm run build:wagtail && pnpm run wagtail:setup && pnpm run wagtail:serve
scripts.prepack: pnpm --filter uncial run prepack && pnpm --filter uncial-cms run prepack
scripts.version: changeset version && node scripts/sync-py-versions.ts && uv lock --project packages/uncial-wagtail
